marketplace_hero_title: Buy mapping services from trusted local teams.
marketplace_hero_subtitle: HOT's Open Mapping Marketplace matches organisations that need local geospatial data to vetted local mapping teams and experts, with HOT managing quality, contracting and payment end to end.
marketplace_whatitis_intro: Most organisations that need local mapping data can’t easily find a local team they trust to deliver it well, and most local mapping teams can’t reach the institutional contracts they’re qualified for.
marketplace_whatitis_body: HOT sits in between: we scope the need, recommend vetted teams from our roster, manage the contract and payment, and quality-check the result before you receive it.
marketplace_whatitis_callout: "The first marketplace is not a technology platform, it's a process."
marketplace_whofor_orgs_title: For organisations that need mapping data
marketplace_whofor_orgs_body: Development banks, UN agencies, national and local governments, INGOs, NGOs and private-sector teams. Get local, high-quality geospatial data without running your own vendor search.
marketplace_whofor_teams_title: For local mapping teams and experts
marketplace_whofor_teams_body: Mapping cooperatives, local OSM communities, drone operators and independent surveyors. Reach institutional contracts you are qualified for, with contracting and payment handled.
marketplace_how_s1_body: A structured intake call turns your request into a scoped, priced brief.
marketplace_how_s2_body: HOT proposes two or three organisations from an accredited local roster. You choose.
marketplace_how_s3_body: Milestone-based payments, HOT-run contracting, and a QA reviewer at handoff.
marketplace_how_s4_body: Backed by a process HOT has run across 60 countries.
marketplace_commission_data_1: Geospatial datasets, rapid and complex mapping
marketplace_commission_data_3: Drone imagery and derived datasets (DTMs, 3D meshes)
marketplace_cta_body: Help us understand your mapping and geospatial data needs so we can recommend the right products, services, and scope for your organisation.
marketplace_cta_note: This form takes approximately 3–5 minutes to complete. All information will be used exclusively to scope your engagement with the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT).
